BindingFailureDetail.description:
Per-binding failure detail surfaced on a NO_DATA ``BuildResult`` (K2).

Mirrors ``app.datasets.contracts.BindingRejection``'s stable fields
without importing the ``app.datasets`` package (see module docstring).
Lets a ``no_data`` result carry an actionable trace of *why* each source
binding was rejected instead of a single collapsed ``no_primary_data``.
(See docs/REVIEW_2026-08-10-task-9ce0124f.md §5.3 K2.)
BindingFailureDetail.title: BindingFailureDetail

BuildResult.description:
Business outcome of a normally completed build (ARCHITECTURE §9.1).

Only produced when ``RunStatus == COMPLETED``; execution failures and
user cancellation are expressed by RunStatus, not by this enum.
BuildResult.title: BuildResult

SourceBinding.description: One source selected by the Agent for a build (Design §8.3).
SourceBinding.title: SourceBinding

SourceBindingAcquisition.description: How a source is acquired: trusted builtin or a promoted WorkflowRecipe.
SourceBindingAcquisition.title: SourceBindingAcquisition

DatasetBuildSpec.description:
Self-contained build input produced by the Agent (ARCHITECTURE §3.1).

The Agent cannot embed executable steps or acceptance thresholds; unknown
fields are rejected by the base model.
DatasetBuildSpec.title: DatasetBuildSpec

DatasetPublication.description:
Atomically promoted immutable version (ARCHITECTURE §9.1; Design §8.9).

``final`` is just the session pointer ``current_publication_id``, never an
intrinsic artifact state.
DatasetPublication.title: DatasetPublication

Per-binding failure detail surfaced on a NO_DATA ``BuildResult`` (K2).

Mirrors ``app.datasets.contracts.BindingRejection``'s stable fields
without importing the ``app.datasets`` package (see module docstring).
Lets a ``no_data`` result carry an actionable trace of *why* each source
binding was rejected instead of a single collapsed ``no_primary_data``.

BindingFailureDetail.title: BindingFailureDetail

BuildResult.description:
Business outcome of a normally completed build (ARCHITECTURE §9.1).

Only produced when ``RunStatus == COMPLETED``; execution failures and
user cancellation are expressed by RunStatus, not by this enum.
BuildResult.title: BuildResult

OperationCompletedPayload.description:
One operation reached a terminal success/skip state.

``label`` / ``category`` are optional (T3); see OperationProgressPayload.
OperationCompletedPayload.title: OperationCompletedPayload

OperationFailedPayload.description:
One operation failed or was cancelled.

``label`` / ``category`` are optional (T3); see OperationProgressPayload.
OperationFailedPayload.title: OperationFailedPayload

OperationProgressPayload.description:
Mid-operation progress (rows parsed, candidates found, ...).

``label`` / ``category`` are optional (T3): pre-T3 events.jsonl and the V2
executor's emissions omit them; the pipeline stage mirror fills them.
OperationProgressPayload.title: OperationProgressPayload

OperationStartedPayload.description:
One operation started (V2 build execution; Design §15.1; T3 stage mirror).

``label`` / ``category`` are stable display strings the frontend groups and
icons by (ARCHITECTURE §14.2). V2 skeleton operations emit them here;
the pipeline stage mirror (``stage_operation_spec``) emits them on every
operation event so the UI never needs the StageName union.
OperationStartedPayload.title: OperationStartedPayload

PublicationCreatedPayload.description:
Immutable publication record appended to the event log (ARCHITECTURE §9.3).

``supersedes_publication_id`` is optional: the reducer derives the chain
head from the task's prior ``current_publication_id`` when the field is
absent, so the emit path never needs the current snapshot.
PublicationCreatedPayload.title: PublicationCreatedPayload

SourceCapability.description:
Pipeline input-level capability of a data source (TODO §1.4).

Distinguishes sources the deterministic Pipeline has accepted
(search/metadata/download/parse/validate closed loop) from sources that
are Agent-only research channels or pending integration. A source marked
``research_only`` may be used for investigation but must never be routed
into the Pipeline as if it were a verified data source.
SourceCapability.title: SourceCapability

SourceCapabilityDeclaration.description:
Pipeline input-level capability declaration for one source (TODO §1.4).

``database`` is the canonical ``Database`` member; ``identifier`` records
the user-facing identifier that was selected (e.g. ``xena`` for
``ucsc_xena``) so the declaration stays truthful to what was requested.
SourceCapabilityDeclaration.title: SourceCapabilityDeclaration

StageProgressPayload.description:
Mid-stage progress update (records discovered, bytes downloaded, rows cleaned).

Emitted by Skills (Agent mode via RunContext.emit_progress) or Pipeline
stages (Pipeline mode via StageContext.emit_progress). Lets the frontend
show concrete numbers ("found 23 papers", "cleaned 4821 rows") instead of
only a single "running" stage badge. See docs/REVIEW_2026-07-18.md §4.
StageProgressPayload.title: StageProgressPayload

UserInputRequiredPayload.description:
Unified human-in-the-loop pause request.

The pipeline emits this payload when it needs a human decision before
continuing. ``prompt_kind`` discriminates between plan confirmation
(``plan_confirmation``), data correction (``data_correction``), and
Agent max_turns exhaustion (``max_turns_reached``). When
``fixture_exempt`` is true the run is in fixture mode and the request is
informational only — the pipeline auto-approves and does not block.
UserInputRequiredPayload.title: UserInputRequiredPayload

ValidationResult.description: Whether a manifest digest passed a profile (ARCHITECTURE §9.1).
ValidationResult.title: ValidationResult
